show.description: After being humiliated by the girl he loves, a broke college student accidentally gains Kubera’s infinite wealth and Kamadev’s power over attraction. As he rises through luxury, revenge, and desire, a divine karma system tracks every choice, forcing him to decide whether true worth comes from control, validation, or letting go.
